name: Optimize CAD and Republish
description: Downloads a CAD asset, tessellates and decimates it to a GLB with an Asset Transformer custom script, then creates a new Asset Manager asset and uploads the result.

inputParameters.name: projectId
inputParameters.description: The project containing the asset to process.

inputParameters.name: assetId
inputParameters.description: The asset containing the files to process.

inputParameters.name: assetVersionId
inputParameters.description: The asset version containing the files to process.

inputParameters.script:
import argparse, glob, os
import pxz
from pxz import io, algo, scene

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--input-dir', default='/workspace/input')
    p.add_argument('--output', default='/workspace/output/model.glb')
    p.add_argument('--ratio', type=float, default=0.5)
    a = p.parse_args()
    sources = [f for ext in ('*.step','*.stp','*.jt','*.fbx') for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(a.input_dir, ext))]
    root = io.importScene(sources[0])
    algo.repairCAD([root], 0.1, True)
    algo.tessellateRelativelyToAABB([root], -1, 0.0005, -1, 15.0)
    algo.repairMesh([root], 0.1, True, False)
    algo.decimateTarget([root], ['ratio', a.ratio])
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(a.output), exist_ok=True)
    io.exportScene(a.output, root)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
